defaults.evidence: Use the original observed offer title or traceable product-label evidence, not the selected pantry name or market group. A brand, package size or missing flavor/fat wording proves no qualification. Plain must be explicit for cottage cheese/Greek yogurt. Named sour cream without dip/flavor modifiers establishes plain sour cream only; regular/full-fat/light qualification is separate.
defaults.cheese: Only natural dairy cheese. Block/shredded are one identity after shredding in the recipe; no quantity/yield conversion. Low-moisture needs explicit evidence; shredded/part-skim/whole-milk alone is insufficient. Fresh mozzarella is separate. Plain Monterey Jack excludes Pepper/Colby Jack. Regular cheddar/Jack excludes explicit reduced-fat/fat-free or processed cheese food.
defaults.blends: Mexican-style means an explicitly named natural dairy blend, not queso dip or every Mexican cheese. A blend establishes none of its individual components. Generic melting blend requires shredding/melting evidence; unknown blend composition has no current recipe permission.
defaults.reject: Reject brand-only/generic cheese, unresolved alternatives, plant-based products, processed cheese food/spreads/slices, sauces/dips/soups/meals, breaded sticks, flavored cottage cheese, dry curds, frozen yogurt desserts, yogurt drinks, non-Greek yogurt as Greek, contradictory fat/flavor/moisture and uncertain qualifications.
defaults.storage: Refrigerated natural dairy forms only for offer admission. Frozen dairy/yogurt desserts and thawed dairy offers are not reviewed by this packet. Pantry availability remains a user boolean independent of storage/date/quantity.
defaults.prices: No new fixed prices. Keep observed history/retail units. Filter each original offer for the specific recipe before cheapest-per-store selection and preserve the selected store pool. No group-average or cheap sibling relabeling.

decisions.rationale: Association only, not ownership or recipe permission. Require exact natural dairy food and any requested flavor, moisture and fat evidence from the original title or traceable product label. Generic/brand wording does not prove a subtype.
